description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy scores for several different models or model configurations. The horizontal axis displays the category labels: RoBERTa w/o Exp, ExEnt, LaSQuE (mean), LaSQuE, and LaSQuE (syn2real + curriculum). The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, represents a linear scale ranging from 40% to 65%, with tick marks at 5% intervals. Five bars are presented, each corresponding to a category on the horizontal axis. The “RoBERTa w/o Exp” bar is light gray and extends to approximately 46%. The “ExEnt” bar is light blue and reaches approximately 54%. The “LaSQuE (mean)” bar is orange and extends to approximately 58%. The “LaSQuE” bar is purple and reaches approximately 62%. Finally, the “LaSQuE (syn2real + curriculum)” bar is dark gray and extends to approximately 64%. The bars are arranged alphabetically according to their labels. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
